arabic_parts.reason: Arabic parts require a true Ascendant from observer lat/lon. This universal feed does not invent ASC=Sun. Compute parts on-device with Placidus ASC/MC.

snapshot_schedule_utc.note: App may pick nearest ISO timestamp in bodies[*].snapshots

houses.reason: Universal weekly feed is geocentric and location-independent. House cusps, ASC, and MC require the user's lat/lon and must be computed on-device (Placidus). No whole-sign house fields are emitted here; ASC is never approximated as the Sun.
